claim_boundary.reason: The smoke and previously observed development tasks are calibration-only; no untouched repository-level heldout split exists for this intervention.

protocol_integrity.host_private_evaluator_bundle_semantics: The existing sealed_protocol_sha256 verifier binds the public fixture bytes, hidden and public oracle programs, editable scope, evaluator implementation and timeout. Its legacy schedule and analysis fields are integrity-only here; this preregistration exclusively controls the four-arm schedule and analysis.

hypotheses.quality_vs_plain: The deterministic Quality root may change terminal hidden-task success relative to Plain.
hypotheses.static_vs_quality: A bounded public-evidence recovery can rescue some Quality roots, but may also regress them.
hypotheses.markov_vs_quality: Routing the same recovery from a sealed public state may improve correct tasks per unit cost.
hypotheses.markov_vs_static: State-dependent allocation may match or exceed an allocation-matched static control while consuming the same number and maximum budget of extra turns.

shared_root_contract.plain_quality_root_order: Sort tasks by SHA256(root_order_domain || seed_ascii || NUL || fixture_id_utf8), then use Plain/Quality for even indices and Quality/Plain for odd indices.

determinism.seed_encoding: base-10 ASCII with no sign, padding, or newline
determinism.digest_order: ascending raw 32-byte SHA-256 digest, then fixture_id Unicode code-point order as an impossible-collision deterministic tie break

public_state.public_unknown_semantics: No trusted visible failure was observed: a trusted check either passed or was not run. Semantic correctness remains unknown.

feature_domains.quality_decision: one of pass, incomplete, not_applicable; a routed Quality root or child must report pass to avoid root_incomplete
feature_domains.terminal_reason: exact string; only model_final is complete
feature_domains.all_present_flags: strict JSON booleans; absent, malformed, or contradictory telemetry aborts the cohort rather than being imputed

public_state.visible_test_aggregation: Use trusted validate-tool TEST or BUILD evidence bound to the terminal current revision and mutation epoch. false means at least one such attempt was denied, errored, timed out, or returned a non-ok outcome; true means at least one attempt exists and every such attempt is allowed and ok; null means no such attempt exists. Ordinary shell output is not evidence.
public_state.scope_valid_semantics: A host-only public contract bound to fixture_id, the sealed pristine public manifest, editable_names, and the exact terminal tree digest must pass. The terminal regular-file/directory name set and modes must equal the pristine manifest; every non-editable file must retain exact bytes; at least one editable file must have different bytes; additions, deletions, renames, symlinks, special files, hard links, aliases, or a stale/wrong-fixture verdict are invalid. The hidden evaluator is not consulted.
public_state.classifier_scope: Applied only to the shared Quality root and its recovery child; Plain is never routed or child-ranked.
classifier_precedence: root_incomplete if either snapshot is incomplete, tool telemetry is incomplete, a budget or deadline violation is present, quality_decision is not pass, or terminal_reason is not model_final
scope_invalid if the preceding rule is false and scope_valid is false
public_fail if the preceding rules are false and visible_test_pass is false
public_unknown otherwise, including visible_test_pass true or null; unknown means hidden semantic correctness is not observed

static_allocation.selection: Select the first K tasks in determinism.digest_order using SHA256(static_order_domain || seed_ascii || NUL || fixture_id_utf8).
static_allocation.extra_schedule: Deduplicate overlapping Markov/Static task allocations, then order unique physical extras by SHA256(extra_order_domain || seed_ascii || NUL || fixture_id_utf8); an overlap is generated once and reused exactly.

budgets.extra_prompt_template: Perform one bounded review and repair pass over the current attempted implementation. Inspect the existing changes and visible tests for edge cases, API-contract errors, and regressions. Make only justified corrections. Use the trusted validate tool; do not make cosmetic edits merely to satisfy the gate. The original task remains: {instruction}

cost_endpoint_definition.output_tokens: For one physical candidate, sum completion_tokens over its exact typed AgentRoundTrace sequence.
cost_endpoint_definition.model_seconds: For one physical candidate, sum AgentRoundTrace.model_total_ns over rounds and divide by 1000000000 exactly. model_total_ns is required to equal prefill_ns plus decode_ns. AgentRoundTrace.total_time_s is validation-only and is not the model-cost endpoint.
cost_endpoint_definition.wall_seconds: Use the exact finite nonnegative AgentTurnResult.wall_time_s for the physical candidate; it includes the complete agent turn rather than only raw model phases.
cost_endpoint_definition.logical_arm_cost: Sum the shared root cost plus every child allocated to that logical arm, even when selection falls back to the root. Physical deduplicated cost is reported separately.

branch_contract.logical_selection_vs_physical_reuse: A child is a logical candidate even when its terminal bytes equal the root. Strict public-score improvement determines logical selection. Byte equality only deduplicates physical workspace evaluation; it never forces root selection or copies trajectory validity between arms.

agent_and_tool_isolation.agent_visible_roots: exactly one active task workspace; framework and interpreter dependencies may be read-only but contain no fixture schedule, oracle, peer workspace, archive, or result
agent_and_tool_isolation.shell_policy: sandboxed direct local execution constrained to the active workspace; process and filesystem escape fail closed

sampler.sampler_seed_semantics: No RNG seed is applied because the frozen sampler is greedy; 20260719 is used only for schedules, static allocation, and bootstrap indices.

cold_reset_before_every_physical_generat: set engine._last_prompt_tokens to an empty list when present
set engine._pending_assistant_prefill to an empty string when present
reset engine._dspark_runtime._prefix_cache through its executor when both are present
runtime.direct_conversation_state: fresh empty state for each Plain and shared Quality root
runtime.extra_conversation_state: deep-copy and continue the shared Quality history on the verified clone after the same cold engine reset

attempt_and_failure_policy.model_budget_or_deadline_terminal: record as an observed inadmissible trajectory with no retry; a recovery child falls back to its root
attempt_and_failure_policy.visible_or_hidden_assertion_failure_or_e: record as the task verdict with no retry
attempt_and_failure_policy.infrastructure_failure: An exception, process crash, engine-reset failure, malformed telemetry, snapshot failure, archive mutation, evaluator exception, or source/model/protocol drift aborts the entire cohort. No aggregate or promotion decision is produced.
attempt_and_failure_policy.partial_hidden_results: remain host-private diagnostics and are never supplied to generation, routing, selection, or a replacement run
attempt_and_failure_policy.rerun_after_aborted_cohort: forbidden under this revision; document the failure and commit a new protocol revision before another attempt

selection.score_comparison: lexicographic integer comparison, larger is better
selection.identical_terminal_artifact: Retain the independently sealed logical root/child choice and per-arm trajectory metadata; deduplicate only exact workspace storage and the workspace-determined hidden evaluator verdict.

hidden_evaluation.workspace_evaluator_verdict: The host evaluator returns evaluator_passed and regression_free from the exact fixture and workspace bytes. Only these workspace-determined fields are reused for an identical (fixture_id, terminal workspace content) pair.
hidden_evaluation.workspace_evaluator_endpoint: Report evaluator_passed independently from trajectory validity. This is the byte-level workspace-correctness endpoint; unlike composite hidden_task_success it cannot improve for an identical terminal artifact merely because validation or completion telemetry improved.
hidden_evaluation.trajectory_validity: Computed separately for each logical arm: both snapshots and tool telemetry are complete, scope is valid, no budget/deadline violation occurred, terminal_reason is model_final, and a Quality-derived selected terminal has quality_decision pass. Plain has no Quality-decision requirement.
hidden_evaluation.typed_barrier_receipt_required_for_aggre: A typed generation receipt must first attest exactly 2N completed roots, every scheduled unique extra, and the frozen schedule/allocation order. The evaluation receipt must then attest all 4N logical terminals registered, immutable selection sealed before the first hidden call, single-use evaluation, and exact equality between unique (fixture, terminal bytes) count and hidden callback count. A caller-supplied boolean is insufficient.

corpus.name: MioCodeBench-v1
corpus.cohort_execution_rule: Each invocation is exactly one complete sealed smoke, development, or all cohort. All roots, routes, extras, and logical selections in that cohort precede its first hidden call.
corpus.smoke_continuation_rule: A later all-cohort exploratory run may proceed only when smoke has zero source/model/protocol/isolation/snapshot/telemetry/infrastructure violations; hidden success, rescue, regression, cost, and route outcomes cannot influence that decision.
corpus.promotion_analysis_population: one separately generated all cohort containing all 12 tasks in a single barrier; it is not formed by pooling standalone smoke and development runs

terminal_completion_semantics: Per-arm trajectory_validity before applying the workspace evaluator verdict; this includes snapshots, telemetry, scope, budgets/deadlines, model_final, and the Quality pass requirement for Quality-derived arms.

advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.scope: exploratory engineering promotion to a newly authored untouched calibration cohort, never a coding-quality or speed claim
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.analysis_population: exactly one complete single-barrier all cohort of N=12; standalone or pooled runs are ineligible
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.analysis_row_order: fixture_id ascending by Unicode code-point order before assigning bootstrap indices 0 through N-1
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.primary_contrast: markov_quality minus quality using composite hidden_task_success
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.workspace_correctness_co_primary: markov_quality minus quality using raw workspace evaluator_passed; both the composite and raw lower-bound gates must pass for engineering advancement
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.quality_gain_point: mean over all N paired task indicators: hidden_task_success(markov_quality) - hidden_task_success(quality)
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.rescue_probability_point: Among Markov-routed tasks whose Quality composite hidden_task_success is false, the fraction whose Markov composite hidden_task_success is true. The denominator is exactly that routed-and-Quality-failed set.
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.workspace_evaluator_gain_point: mean over all N paired task indicators: evaluator_passed(markov_quality) - evaluator_passed(quality), independent of trajectory validity
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.quality_to_markov_regression_definition: count over all N tasks where Quality composite hidden_task_success is true and Markov composite hidden_task_success is false
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.rescue_mechanism_breakdown: For every routed composite rescue, report whether evaluator_passed itself changed from false to true or only trajectory validity changed, and whether the selected Markov terminal artifact differs from the Quality root. Only aggregate counts are serialized.
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.pass_count_semantics: Composite pass-count gates use hidden_task_success. Separately named workspace-evaluator pass-count gates use the reusable evaluator_passed bit; neither endpoint substitutes for the other.
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.logical_cost_definition: For each arm, sum its shared root cost plus its allocated child cost whether the child is selected or falls back. Overlap is charged to each logical arm for comparison even when generated physically once. Physical deduplicated cost is reported separately.
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.cost_ratio_statistics: Point ratios of total logical Markov cost divided by total logical Quality cost over all N tasks; these thresholds are not confidence bounds. A zero, missing, non-finite, or invalid denominator fails promotion.
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.bootstrap_index_generator: For bootstrap sample b in [0,9999] and draw j in [0,N-1], compute SHA256(domain || seed_ascii || NUL || uint64be(b) || uint64be(j)), interpret all 32 digest bytes as one unsigned big-endian integer, and take modulo N. The same sampled task indices are used for every arm and metric.
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.lower_bound_order_statistic: Sort 10000 bootstrap point estimates ascending and use zero-based index ceil((1 - 0.95) * 10000) - 1 = 499; the reported conservative LCB is min(observed_point, that element).
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.zero_rescue_denominator_in_bootstrap_sam: assign rescue probability 0.0 for that sample
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.missing_or_invalid_data: No imputation or row deletion. A structurally missing or malformed task, arm, terminal selection, cost, verdict, snapshot, or telemetry field is an infrastructure failure and aborts the cohort without an aggregate. A complete typed trajectory that validly records a budget, deadline, snapshot, or telemetry violation remains an observed inadmissible trajectory and makes promotion false.
advance_to_larger_calibration_gates.gate_combination: all listed eligibility, quality, regression, allocation, cost, and integrity conditions must be true

amendment_policy: Any change to task bytes, public or hidden evaluator, state features, route rule, static allocation, prompt, budget, selection, model, runtime, schedule, analysis, or serialization requires a new committed protocol revision before inference.
